integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the proof. The literature comparison includes the motivating full text and two later closely related finite-field ETF/SIC works.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only prime powers q with characteristic different from 2 and 3; the modular characteristic-2 and characteristic-3 cases are not classified.
title: Dimension-two finite-field SICs outside characteristics two and three
